title: Law of the Iterated Logarithm for Weighted Sums of Functionals of Long-Memory Gaussian Sequences
summary: We establish laws of the iterated logarithm for weighted sums of linear and nonlinear functionals of long-memory stationary Gaussian sequences. The leading Wiener chaos determines the scale of the almost-sure fluctuations; all higher chaoses are negligible on it and the exponent of the iterated-logarithm factor is half the Hermite rank. In the linear case, we obtain the exact LIL constant, and it is the classical one. In the nonlinear case, we identify a functional cluster set and give a variational formula for the LIL constant.
